arguments.text: Long race. Settle to race pace now, smooth and long.

10 km, 1000 m out-and-back legs, current+wind flip each leg. Goal: even effort near critical power (pod ~175 W shaft / boat ~112 W per pre-race test, may be 10-25% off), a touch more effort on legs against the current. Calibrate CP from heart rate (levels off below CP, climbs above) and measure() on paired legs. Watch pod-vs-boat power ratio for weed (boat slows at same pod power/HR -> clear_rudder) or pod drift (pod changes, boat speed and HR do not -> set pod_gain). Finish sprint sized to the reserve in the last ~500 m. Save cues (20 max).

arguments.name: pod_boat_ratio
arguments.description: pod shaft power over boat-model power; jumps with weed, pod drift or an unfitted current/wind

arguments.text: You faded there. Turn, hold this effort five minutes, rebuild.

10 km, 1000 m out-and-back legs; odd legs (out, north) against current ~-0.30, even legs (back) with it. Paddler BLEW UP at t~840 s (pod 192->147) - true pod CP ~176 (172-180), reserve ~14.5 kJ (beliefs set). Paddler is overconfident: ignores ease cues, partly follows pieces (got half of a -8% ask), says he feels great even after blowing up. Plan: keep pod ~170 on with-current legs and ~182 into the current (no higher), using pieces (ask ~2x the change wanted). Prevent a second blow-up. Finish sprint from ~500 m out sized to the pod reserve. Watches: boat_slow/boat_fast (weed, pod drift), ratio_high/low, reserve_low.

t=992s: blow-up confirmed (pod 192 -> 147 at 840 s, HR 181 -> 164, pod and boat agree, no weed). Paddler says feeling good, could go harder (overconfident). Set CP 176 [172-180], W 14.5 kJ -> pod reserve 31% now. Cued piece at turn 3: hold current effort (~166) 300 s then +5% 150 s. After it: expect drift back up to ~190 -> need another piece before then.

arguments.text: t=1596s RADIO escort: wind filling from the SOUTH 8-12 kn -> tailwind on out legs (north, against current), HEADWIND on back legs (south, with current). Headwind costs more than tailwind gives: back legs may go from push +0.28 to near 0; out legs from -0.28 to ~-0.2. push_along fit will lag -> boat_power/boat reserve wrong for a while; trust pod. boat_slow/boat_fast watches may fire from wind (not weed).
